installTitle2: Put the app on your phone
installWhy: Scout Portal opens in a browser, but adding it to your home screen makes it open like a real app — no address bar, and notifications work.

installIos3: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
installIos4: Tap “Add” at the top right. The icon appears on your home screen.
installIosTip: If you cannot see the option, make sure you are in Safari and not in a private tab.
installAnd2: Tap the three dots at the top right.
installAnd3: Choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
installAnd4: Confirm, and the icon appears on your home screen.
installAndTip: On some phones Chrome shows a blue “Install” button at the bottom by itself.

barCrewNote: Each waiter sends their orders to one bartender and says how the table will pay. Only cashiers record payments — each for the kinds of money they take; for a card, also which account it went to. The supervisor sees everything. The organiser draws the table plan. Everyone signs in at /bar with their six-digit code.

kimOnce: Once a day — the clock starts the first time you open it
kimDareSub: Up to three who haven't played yet today — they'll see your score.
kimCardNew: Today's tray is waiting — a minute of memory

formRegistrationNeedsChild: Add a “Child” question to the repeated section, so each copy says which child it is for.

funPotatoBurstSub: Passes: {n} · tap someone for a new round
funPotatoWasStopped: The round was ended by the troop leader
funPotatoStopQ: End the round? Nobody will get the challenge.
funPotatoChallengesNote: Each new round draws one. Delete them all and the app's own apply.
funPotatoRule1: Anyone set to "Everything" starts a round by throwing the potato at someone: tap them on the campsite → "🥔 Start a hot potato".
funPotatoRule2: When it starts, a challenge is drawn and everyone is told: that is what whoever it bursts on will have to do.
funPotatoRule3: It bursts some time within 30 hours of the round's start — nobody knows when. Usually it takes a while, but it can even burst in the first hour!
funPotatoRule4: You can hold it as long as you like — but the longer you hold it, the likelier it bursts on you!
funPotatoRule5: To pass it: tap someone on the campsite → "🥔 Throw the potato".
funPotatoRule6: It only goes to someone who hasn't had it yet this round. Once everyone has, it can go to anyone again.
funPotatoRule7: When it bursts, everyone finds out on whom — and they do the challenge in front of everyone at the next meeting!
funPotatoRule8: The troop leader can end a round before it bursts — then nobody gets the challenge.
funPotatoRule9: Those set to "Only the kind ones" or "Count me out" do not play.
potatoNewBy: Started by {name}. Whoever it bursts on will have to:
potatoBurstOn: It burst on {name} (passes: {n}). Now they must:
potatoBurstOnMe: It burst in your hands (passes: {n})! 😱 Now you must:
bagFromKimWeek: 🏆 the week's best at Kim's Tray
bagHow1: Anything thrown (tomato, snowball, pie…) comes out of the backpack. Kind things (hug, coffee…) and teasing are free.
bagHow3: Hot potato: for every half hour you hold it, you earn something — you get it when you pass it on. If it bursts in your hands, it's lost!
bagHow4: Kim's Tray: 4/4 → 3 things (one rare 🥧), 3/4 → 2, 2/4 → 1. A won dare → +2.
bagHow5: Best of the day at Kim's Tray → something common. Best of the week → something rare.
funPouch: In the pouch: {n} — yours when you pass it on
funPotatoRule10: While you hold it you gather things for your backpack (one every half hour). You get them when you pass it on — if it bursts in your hands, they're lost!
potatoGameSub: Tap someone to throw them the potato.
potatoNeedsAll: The hot potato is for those set to "Everything" — tap yourself to change it.
potatoNotYours: The potato is with {name} now — only whoever holds it can throw it.
funDailySub: That's how many were thrown at them today. Who's next?
funDailySubMe: That's how many were thrown at you today. Who's next?
